Resource Hunter 2.0.0 is a major overhaul with unified architecture, enhanced search, and improved output modes.

- Unified search interface via hunt.py with clear subcommands and JSON output.
- Internal codebase modularized under scripts/resource_hunter/ with better caching, CLI, and search model separation.
- Added comprehensive tests for hunt, CLI, intent detection, precision search, result formatting, and video handling.
- Major SKILL.md update: now documents modes, intent routing, expected outputs, and agent usage.
- Expanded control for channels (pan/torrent), 4K, and subtitle preferences; legacy scripts remain supported.
- Adds full reference documentation for usage, architecture, and source coverage.

- Revamped and expanded the skill description for improved clarity and details.
- Highlighted new features: intelligent resource type recognition, quality-first sorting, and concurrent searches.
- Updated quick start guide and parameter table for clearer usage instructions.
- Added explicit dependency instructions and detailed data sources overview.
- Modernized formatting with clear sections and improved ease of reading.

- Improved cloud drive support: now aggregates results from 10+ drives, including 阿里云盘, 夸克, 百度, 115, UC, PikPak, and more.
- Enhanced search options: added --sub for prioritized subtitle results and --4k for 4K content preference.
- Updated usage instructions for clarity and expanded examples; simplified recommended keyword strategies.
- Expanded "AI 使用指南" and search trigger examples for better integration with smart agents.
- Improved documentation for filtering, picking versions, and specifying content quality.
- No API Key required; all APIs remain free and public.

Initial release of resource-hunter.

- Supports aggregated cloud drive search (Aliyun, Quark, Baidu, 115, PikPak, etc.).
- Provides torrent search (TPB, Nyaa, 1337x) and anime-specialized search.
- Enables video downloads from 1000+ sites (YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok, etc.).
- Offers subtitle extraction and audio-only download.
- Follows an agent decision flow to select the optimal resource path based on user needs.
- Requires yt-dlp for video downloads; other features work with standard Python.
